# Urban Service Company

> Urban Service Company provides same-day appliance repair in Bengaluru, India with specialized expertise in Microwave Oven Repair (Solo, Grill, Convection), ACs, washing machines, refrigerators, water filters/RO purifiers, and kitchen chimneys. Verified technicians, free diagnosis, genuine spare parts, quality assured repair across 85 neighbourhoods.

- [Microwave Oven Repair](https://urbanservicecompany.in/services/microwave-repair) — #1 Flagship Specialist for Solo, Grill, and Convection ovens (LG, Samsung, IFB, Whirlpool, Panasonic, Godrej, Bajaj).
- [AC Repair & Service](https://urbanservicecompany.in/services/ac-repair)
